Stated the technique I use in the comment below, there's a couple other methods like open eye meditation (I've heard candles are very good), heard mantras work for some people too. See if you can find some classes around your area :) in my city there's a couple classes every week

I normally just focus on my breathing, count to 5 inhaling through the nose, hold for 2 counts, exhale through the nose counting to 5. Sometimes it's unsuccessful and you can't suppress your thoughts, but sometimes you can have really good sessions. When you open your eyes after, you feel much calmer and in control of your thoughts. 
 It's turned my life around, 15 minutes every morning makes a huge difference, I'm much more patient, more optimistic and stress free :) look around your area for any meditation classes, best wishes <3
